# macOS Sparkle appcast

`appcast.xml` is generated by `trails_rg_apps/tool/macos_sparkle_release.sh` and
should live here as:

- `dist/appcast.xml` — feed URL used by the Mac app (`SUFeedURL`)

Do not invent signatures by hand. Always run `sign_update` via the release script
so `sparkle:edSignature` matches the Keychain private key paired with
`SUPublicEDKey` in the app.

See `trails_rg_apps/docs/MACOS_UPDATES.md`.
